_about: Official places to report scams, by country. Each link was checked on an official government or charity website (Oct 2026). Update this file as services change.

links.name: Nigeria Police National Cybercrime Centre (NPF-NCCC) e-reporting portal
EFCC (Economic and Financial Crimes Commission), incl. the Eagle Eye reporting app

GB.name: United Kingdom (England, Wales, Northern Ireland)
GB.note: In Scotland, call Police Scotland on 101.

default.name: Anywhere

links.name: FBI IC3 accepts complaints from people in any country

default.note: Also report to your local police and to the app or platform where the scammer contacted you.

intimate_images.name: StopNCII.org: helps stop intimate images of adults spreading on major platforms
Take It Down (NCMEC): for images taken when you were under 18

always: If you sent money or shared card or bank details, contact your bank or payment app immediately and ask them to stop or recall the payment.
Report the scammer's account in the app where they contacted you.
Keep screenshots and don't delete the chat: they are evidence.
